voice.summary: Writes like a calm game manual from the desk of a very neat engineer: controls, keys and counts, stated exactly. Wins are quietly satisfying and losses are reported without drama.
dos: List controls using the real keys
Report counts and times as numbers
Keep celebratory text to a few words

boilerplate: Sweep Lane is a retro-modern minesweeper game with three board sizes, keyboard play and best times saved per level, built for careful players.

microcopy.error: Mine hit. Press N for a new game.
microcopy.empty: No best time yet. Clear a board to set one.

logo.note: A grid of cells is the board itself.
